label: Bible Study
prompt: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt _____ therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
verse: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
note: Joshua's marching orders after Moses died — success, it turns out, starts with a book.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But the very hairs of your head are all _____.
verse: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
note: God's attention to detail extends to your hairline — every strand is numbered, even the ones leaving.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was _____ with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
verse: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
note: Jonathan, the king's son and heir, loved David as his own soul — one of the Bible's great friendships.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But godliness with _____ is great gain.
verse: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
note: False teachers treated godliness as a way to get rich; Paul agrees it's great gain — just not that kind.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the _____, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
verse: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
note: Look back while plowing and the furrow goes crooked. The KJV spells it the British way: 'plough.'
